```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

Editing the old file in place won't work in this repo. The project notes say everything in `migrations/` has already been applied in production. If you changed `0007`, production would keep its `emial` column, but new databases would get `email`, and the two would drift apart. The repo's rule is to add the next numbered file instead.

(The notifier's migrations in `services/notifier/migrations/` are different: they haven't been applied anywhere yet, so they can still be edited in place until it launches in 2026-11.)

Nothing else in the repo uses `emial`, so no code needs changing. I haven't committed anything.
